snippet.title: Finals Week - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Finals Week, a first-person co-op cheating simulation game developed by Studio Cimosa. Players will do whatever it takes to survive the last week of school with friends in co-op. Steal the answers to the exam, share information with friends, and graduate by any means necessary. Finals Week is coming soon to PC (Steam).
